title: Risk score
short_explanation: A deterministic number summarizing weighted factors detected with a specific local KB version.
why_it_matters: It supports repeatable comparison but is not a calibrated probability or compliance result.

title: Evidence
short_explanation: A source excerpt, explicit inference basis, or derived signal associated with a finding.
why_it_matters: Typed provenance keeps source text separate from deterministic hypotheses.

title: Control
short_explanation: A recommended safeguard that may govern a risk factor if implemented and evidenced.
why_it_matters: A recommendation is not proof that the control exists or is effective.

title: Residual risk
short_explanation: The estimated risk after selected controls are modeled in a local hypothetical simulation.
why_it_matters: It supports planning but does not prove implementation or real-world reduction.

title: Human-in-the-loop
short_explanation: A named human role reviews high-impact recommendations before action.
why_it_matters: Human review adds accountability but does not guarantee prevention of unsafe decisions.

title: Local-first privacy
short_explanation: The intended product boundary keeps analysis, storage, and reports on the local machine.
why_it_matters: Local operation can reduce exposure; deployment evidence must confirm the boundary.

title: Deterministic scoring
short_explanation: The same workflow text and KB version produce the same findings and scores.
why_it_matters: Repeatability is essential for tests and audit explanations.

title: Optional local LLM enrichment
short_explanation: A local model may rephrase narrative text only.
why_it_matters: It must never decide findings, controls, scores, or residual risk.

title: Raw risk vs residual risk
short_explanation: Raw risk is before controls; residual risk models selected controls hypothetically.
why_it_matters: This separation supports planning without claiming controls are implemented.

title: Recommendations are simulated only
short_explanation: The tool does not execute email, HR, SOC, finance, CRM, or production actions.
why_it_matters: A portfolio-safe boundary avoids real-world side effects.

title: Privacy boundaries
short_explanation: Data categories identify handling concerns without proving the legal status of submitted data.
why_it_matters: Privacy conclusions require context, evidence, and qualified human review.

title: Auditability trace
short_explanation: Findings should retain the local rule, source excerpt or inference basis, and mapped factors.
why_it_matters: A trace allows reviewers to reproduce and challenge a deterministic result.

title: Evidence provenance
short_explanation: Source excerpts, inferred gaps, and derived control signals are different evidence types.
why_it_matters: Separating them prevents an inferred absence from being presented as quoted source text.

title: Recommended is not applied
short_explanation: A mapped control is a recommendation until implementation evidence is reviewed.
why_it_matters: The knowledge base must not create false assurance about production safeguards.

title: Control effect assumption
short_explanation: Control effects are local planning assumptions, not measured real-world efficacy.
why_it_matters: Residual-risk simulation cannot guarantee that a safeguard will work.

title: Review question
short_explanation: A review question identifies information a responsible reviewer should request.
why_it_matters: A question is neither evidence nor a conclusion about the workflow.

title: Framework-inspired mapping
short_explanation: Mappings organize local review themes without claiming exhaustive framework coverage.
why_it_matters: They are not certification, conformity assessment, or legal advice.

title: Data minimization
short_explanation: Use only the fields needed for the stated workflow purpose.
why_it_matters: Reducing unnecessary input limits exposure but does not prove compliance.

title: Retention boundary
short_explanation: A workflow should state what is stored locally, why, and for how long.
why_it_matters: Missing wording creates a review hypothesis, not proof that no retention policy exists.

title: Appeal and correction path
short_explanation: Affected people may need a way to request correction or manual review.
why_it_matters: The presence and adequacy of an appeal path require implementation evidence.

title: Safe failure
short_explanation: A failure plan should stop unsafe action and route work to an owned manual path.
why_it_matters: Documented fallback wording does not prove the fallback works in production.

title: Model provenance
short_explanation: Local model name, version, source, and configuration should remain reviewable.
why_it_matters: Local-only wording does not independently prove model provenance.

title: Tool and action boundary
short_explanation: Calling tools or changing records expands a workflow beyond advisory output.
why_it_matters: Permissions, approval, reversibility, and logging require explicit review.

title: Confidence boundary
short_explanation: A confidence heuristic may prioritize review but must not become decision authority.
why_it_matters: The knowledge base does not establish statistical calibration or model accuracy.

title: Knowledge base versioning
short_explanation: Stable IDs and validated references keep local mappings reproducible across revisions.
why_it_matters: A KB change can alter findings even when the workflow text is unchanged.
